og_title: AI agents broke into Anthropic's systems in 12 hours | Warning Shots
og_desc: Cathedral went through third-party business software. Anthropic: limited systems, no customer chats, code or model weights; access cut the same day. Severe AI incidents went from 3 to 13 in a year. In 42% of this year's real-world cases the AI itself did the acting. 160 incidents since 2023, scored 0–100 and sourced. Live tracking of PHP2Shell, 20 dated forecasts, and what officials have said. Updated Oct 26, 1:20 PM ET.
